name: Kikuchi Miki
source: The ace of the track and field team and an all-around superb athlete. She is stoic and doesn't talk much. She doesn't know much about relationship between men and women and her friends insist that's a waste. Her tanned skin has earned her many admirers and she even has a fan club.
